fact: 英国《机动车法1903》（Motor Car Act 1903）于1903年8月14日获御准，正式名称为“修订1896年道路上机动车法的法案”（An Act to amend the Locomotives on Highways Act, 1896），是1903年英国机动车管理的基础立法，后于1930年《道路交通法》废止。

fact: 1903年英国尚无和平时期入境管制：1826—1905年间英国边境开放，1852年外交大臣格兰维尔勋爵指示称依英国法律所有外国人拥有不受限制入境与居住的权利；英国内政部国籍史文件确认英国第一部现代移民法是1905年《外国人法》（1905年8月11日御准）。

sources.title: Prof. Leslie Thomas, Refugees: English Law's Protection or Persecution?（Gresham College讲座，经ein.org.uk发布）
sources.quote: between 1826 and 1905 there were no immigration controls as we know them today. The UK had open borders. In fact, the Foreign Secretary, Lord Granville, said in a directive to all British missions in 1852: "By the existing laws of Great Britain, all foreigners have the unrestricted right of entrance and residence in this country … No foreigner, as such, can be sent out of the country by the Executive Government"

sources.title: Historical background information on nationality（GOV.UK / Home Office）
sources.quote: The first modern immigration statute had been the Aliens Act 1905 which, as the title indicates, applied only to aliens (foreign nationals).

fact: 伦敦码头日工工资以1889年大罢工确立的6便士/小时（docker's tanner）、加班8便士/小时为长期基准，按每周48小时折算约合1英镑4先令；该标准是1900年代初码头零工的主要工资参照。

sources.title: The 1889 London dockers' & tailors' strikes | London Museum
sources.quote: The demand for increased rates of pay to be 6d or 'tanner' ( around £2 now) per hour for day work with 8d per hour overtime resulted in the strike being referred to as the 'dockers' tanner'. ... The agreement conceded most of the dockers' demands, including the 'dockers tanner'.

fact: 查尔斯·布斯伦敦生活与劳动调查所复述的家庭预算显示：东区“极贫”阶层每名成人每周平均收入5先令1便士，其中房租1先令3便士、食物3先令7便士；贫困阶层每名成人周收入7先令7便士、房租1先令8便士——该19世纪末调查数字是1903年东区生存预算的量级参照。

sources.title: Early Innovations in Social Research: The Poverty Survey of Charles Booth (Bales, LSE Theses Online)
sources.quote: The average income per adult per week among the "very poor" was 5s 1d; rent would take 1s 3d of this and food a further 3s 7d.

fact: 英国短期利率（普通资金当代序列，年均值）1903年为3.41%，1902年为2.97%、1904年为2.68%——1903年英国货币市场利率高于前后两年，处于战争后重建期的偏紧状态。

fact: 《每日邮报》1896年5月4日由Alfred与Harold Harmsworth兄弟创刊于伦敦，为定价半便士的大众日报；到1900年前后日发行量约100万份、成为全球销量最大的日报，1903年英国廉价大众报业已成型（另有资料称1899年54.5万份、1902年破百万，口径有差异）。

sources.title: Early Edition: the Daily Mail, British newspapers, and the moving image, 1896-1922 (Tom Rice, University of St Andrews)
sources.quote: The first edition of the Daily Mail on May 4 1896 included an advertisement for the "latest scientific marvel,"the Lumiere Cinematograph. ... The concurrent growth of the Daily Mail –which with a daily circulation of one million by 1900 was the largest selling newspaper in the world –is the most striking example of a new popular,affordable press.

sources.title: The History of Newspapers (archive.org)
sources.quote: In 1896, the brothers Alfred and Harold Harmsworth, who were great pioneers of news-papers, established the 'Daily Mail' as a popular, half-penny newspaper. ... By 1900 it had a circulation of over one million copies every day.
